medicine.rule_text: The JAMB UTME subject combination for Medicine and Surgery is Physics, Chemistry and Biology, with English compulsory.

law.rule_text: Candidates need English plus any three Arts or Social Science subjects.
law.quote: Any three Arts or Social Science subjects.

nursing.rule_text: UTME candidates for Nursing/Nursing Science require English plus Chemistry, Biology and Physics.

pharmacy.rule_text: UTME candidates for Pharmacy require English plus Physics, Chemistry and Biology.

mls.rule_text: Candidates must take English, Physics, Chemistry and Biology.

physiotherapy.rule_text: UTME candidates for Physiotherapy require Physics, Chemistry and Biology, with English being compulsory.

dentistry.rule_text: Candidates must take English, Chemistry, Biology and one other science subject (often Physics, as required by many universities).
dentistry.quote: Chemistry, Biology and one (1) other Science subject

computer-science.rule_text: Candidates must take English, Mathematics and Physics, plus one subject from Biology, Chemistry, Agric Science, Economics or Geography.
computer-science.quote: Mathematics, Physics and one of Biology, Chemistry, Agric Science, Economics and Geography

accounting.rule_text: Candidates need English, Mathematics, Economics plus any Social Science subject.
accounting.quote: Mathematics, Economics plus any Social Science subject.

economics.rule_text: Candidates must take English, Economics, and Mathematics, plus one subject from Government, History, Geography, Literature in English, French, or CRS/IRS.
economics.quote: Economics, Mathematics and any of Government, History, Geography, Literature in English, French and CRS/IS.

mass-comm.rule_text: Candidates need English plus any three Arts and Social Science subjects.
mass-comm.quote: Any three (3) Arts and Social Science subjects.

business-admin.rule_text: Candidates must take English, Mathematics, Economics and any other Social Science subject.
business-admin.quote: Mathematics, Economics and any other Social Science subject

political-science.rule_text: Candidates must take English and Government or History, plus two other Social Sciences or Arts subjects.
political-science.quote: Government/History and two (2) other Social Sciences or Arts subjects.

civil-eng.rule_text: The JAMB UTME subject combination for Civil Engineering is English, Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics.

electrical-eng.rule_text: The JAMB UTME subject combination for Electrical Engineering is Mathematics, Physics and Chemistry, with English being compulsory.

mechanical-eng.rule_text: The JAMB UTME subject combination for Mechanical Engineering is Mathematics, Physics and Chemistry, with English being compulsory.

chemical-eng.rule_text: The JAMB UTME subject combination for Chemical Engineering is Mathematics, Physics and Chemistry, with English being compulsory.

petroleum-eng.rule_text: The JAMB UTME subject combination for Petroleum Engineering is English (compulsory), Chemistry, Mathematics, and Physics.

architecture.rule_text: Candidates must take English, Physics, and Mathematics, plus one subject chosen from Chemistry, Geography, Fine Art, Biology, or Economics.
architecture.quote: Physics, Mathematics, and any of Chemistry, Geography, Art, Biology and Economics.

microbiology.rule_text: Candidates must take English, Biology, Chemistry and either Physics or Mathematics.
microbiology.quote: Biology, Chemistry and either Physics or Mathematics.

biochemistry.rule_text: Candidates must take English, Chemistry and Biology plus either Physics or Mathematics.
biochemistry.quote: Chemistry, Biology and Physics or Mathematics.

english.rule_text: Candidates must take English, Literature in English, one other Arts subject and another Arts or Social Science subject.
english.quote: Literature in English, one other Arts subject and another Arts or Social Science subject.

software-eng.rule_text: Candidates must take English, Mathematics and Economics, plus one of Chemistry, Physics, Biology or Geography.
software-eng.quote: Maths, Economics and any one of Chemistry, Physics, Biology or Geography.

cyber-security.rule_text: Candidates must take English, Mathematics, Physics, and one of Biology, Chemistry, Agric Science, Economics or Geography.
cyber-security.quote: Mathematics, Physics and one (1) of Biology, Chemistry, Agric Science, Economics and Geography
